body.heading: Short title and date of operation.
body.raw_text: 1. This Act may be cited as the Registration of Documents (Amendment) Act, No. 21 of 2013 and shall be deemed to have come into operation on January 1, 2013.

body.heading: Amendment of section 13 of the Registration of Documents Ordinance (Chapter 117).
body.raw_text: 2. quality_notes: Parsed from the Government Printer PDF's own text layer, not from OCR. Every word of the source is accounted for in the tree (0.00% unmatched by scripts/check_parse_coverage.py). The defects below are structural -- text placed in the wrong node -- not lost or misread wording.

Section 5 does not appear in the body as its own node. On page 2 the print mirrors the usual Government Printer layout and runs the marginal note down the LEFT column with the provision on the right, which is the regime scripts/parse_amendment_pdf.py expects only inside quoted extracts. Section 5 and its note were therefore read as a continuation of section 4. Its full text -- 'The First Schedule of the principal enactment is hereby amended as follows' and limbs (1)(i), (1)(ii), (1)(iii) and (2) -- is present inside section 4's text.

The body carries duplicate section numbers. Three nodes numbered 1, 2 and 3 appear after section 4; they are the numbered fee items of the Part III table that section 5 substitutes into the First Schedule, not sections of the Act.
Because section 5 is not a node, no amendment instruction is recorded for the First Schedule. The Act does amend it. Read section 4's text, not the instruction list, for that change.
Section 7's text runs on into the back-cover imprint of the printed pamphlet ('Payable to the SUPERINTENDENT, GOVERNMENT PUBLICATIONS BUREAU ...'). That is page furniture, not part of the provision.

This tree was first built through Git Bash, where pdftotext resolves to an Xpdf 4.00 build that ignores '-enc UTF-8'; the result lost every curly quote and em dash to U+FFFD and dropped three further sections. It was rebuilt through PowerShell, where pdftotext resolves to poppler 25.07. Rebuild this tree from PowerShell.
